label: Order
caption: JOHN Q. HAMM, COMMISSIONER, ALABAMA DEPARTEMENT OF CORRECTIONS Applicant V. MICHAEL SOCKWELL
text: UPON CONSIDERATION of the application of counsel for the applicant, IT IS ORDERED that the mandate of the United States Court of Appeals for the Eleventh Circuit, case No. 23-13321, is hereby stayed pending further order of the undersigned or of the Court. It is further ordered that a response to the application be filed on or before Friday, October 3, 2025, by 4 p.m. (EDT).
